description: Checks the figures on a pay stub for internal inconsistencies: gross minus deductions vs net, hours × rate, Social Security and Medicare rates, pay period length, pay date, year-to-date totals, and suspiciously round numbers. Read the numbers off the stub and pass them in. Flags items for follow-up; it does not authenticate a document or prove fraud.

deductions.description: Every deduction line, e.g. Federal, Social Security, Medicare, State, 401k

prior_ytd_gross.description: YTD gross from the previous stub, if available

name: check_pay_stub_math
title: Check pay stub math
